narrative.headline: 2019 Honda Pilot: electrical and engine gripes lead the pack
narrative.summary: Owners filed 847 complaints with NHTSA. Electrical problems top the list at 29% of reports, with engine issues close behind at 25%. The remaining concerns split across the fuel/propulsion system, forward collision avoidance, and the powertrain. Most reports are about malfunctions, not accidents, but a handful note crashes, two mention fires, and several report injuries, so the details below are worth a look.

issues.blurb: The single most common complaint: 249 reports (29%). Owners describe display screens and electronics cutting out. This area is tied to 1 fire, 1 crash, and 3 injuries.

issues.title: Engine
issues.blurb: The second-biggest concern: 213 reports (25%), often vibration with multiple warning lights coming on at once. Linked to 2 fires and 1 injury, but no reported crashes.
